prompts.front:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: SINGLE orthographic FRONT character reference for Meshy multi-view 3D reconstruction, transparent PNG.
Reference image 1 is the approved Vulpin character identity and exact illustration style. Preserve the handsome clean hand-painted cartoon artwork, sharp smooth dark outlines, warm colors, short compact proportions and very large fox head. This is the SAME orange fox thief, not a redesign.
Draw exactly ONE whole character viewed DEAD STRAIGHT FROM THE FRONT, camera level at torso, orthographic with zero top-down tilt, symmetric face looking directly at camera. No three-quarter angle. Neutral symmetrical A pose: both arms straight and extended about 35 degrees away from the vertical body, elbows relaxed almost straight, palms inward, gloved hands empty and visibly separated from hips. Legs straight, feet hip-width apart, both planted level and pointing forward. Entire ears, hands, boots and tail in frame, generous 10% transparent margins.
Identity: orange fox, cream muzzle and inner ears, glossy dark oval eyes, small black nose, olive green fitted hood with two triangular ears protruding, folded olive collar and short layered olive tunic, russet brown trousers, brown leather gauntlets and single continuous brown boots with one cuff each. Broad leather belt with one rectangular brass buckle at center. One diagonal chest strap from the character's anatomical LEFT shoulder (image RIGHT) to the character's anatomical RIGHT hip (image LEFT), one small brown pouch at that RIGHT hip (image LEFT). Small gold rectangular strap buckle. No weapons, no backpack, no cape, no new ornament. Real continuous limbs, no exposed puppet joints.
Tail is one fluffy orange fox tail with cream tip, rooted at the center of the lower back, held behind the body on its midsagittal plane and curving softly upward; do not move it out to either side just to display it in this strict front view. It may be mostly occluded by body in this front view. Preserve short large-headed original proportions; don't make the body slim, tall, adult or realistic.
Polished colored illustration with broad softly shaded readable volumes and original crisp outlines. Soft neutral illumination, no directional cast shadow, no floor, no background, no text, no reference labels, no grid, no extra poses. Deliver actual transparent alpha. Image square 1536x1536 if possible. Center the character's torso on the image vertical centerline; ears at about y=12%, feet at y=88%.

prompts.back:

Image1 canonical FRONT character fixes design, pose and dimensions. Image2 canonical LEFT PROFILE fixes depth, tail shape and volume. Draw the same single Vulpin from exactly BEHIND, a 180-degree camera rotation around the fixed character. Camera level, zero downward tilt, orthographic rear elevation. No face, no muzzle, no eyes or visible chest. Do not create a three-quarter rear angle.
Same large triangular-eared hooded fox with short compact body, warm orange fur, olive green hood and short olive tunic, russet trousers, brown leather gauntlets, empty gloved hands, one-cuff brown boots. SAME symmetrical A pose as front: arms about35degrees away from vertical, hands at same height, legs hip-width apart, straight and both boots pointing away from camera. Heels face viewer. Maintain exact proportion of ear-to-chin height to short body as front.
Rear hood is plain olive fabric with a modest central seam and the same faceted painted shading, not a helmet or cape. Ears seen from behind have orange fur, not exposed cream inner-ear faces. One small pouch is on RIGHT hip (image RIGHT here), same pouch seen on image LEFT in front. Belt wraps continuously, NO gold belt buckle on back.
Single fluffy orange tail with cream tip rooted in center of lower back. In this exact back view it is centered over lower spine, foreshortened, naturally concealing part of rear tunic/strap. No tail off to either side, no extra tail, no dangling tail between boots. The back tail width should be narrower than hood, roughly torso width. Preserve subtle tip asymmetry visible in side view.
Crisp high quality hand-painted cartoon illustration matching references, no realistic fur, no 3D clay shading. Soft neutral lighting. Square transparent image, whole figure, ear tops near6% and heels baseline near92%, same framing as front. No text, labels, floor, ground shadow or props. Actual alpha background.
